criteria.description: The path has one stone per step (start plus track length), and every 5th stone and the finish show their number
criteria.verification: track.test.ts; manual: ?board&length=30 and ?board&length=40 show the right count and numbers

criteria.description: Bunnies are original, built in code from simple shapes, one colour per player, name floating above
criteria.verification: manual: ?board&players=6 shows six differently coloured bunnies with readable names; no model files in the repo

criteria.description: Each bunny stands on the stone for its score; scores past the end wait on the final stone
Bunnies sharing a stone stand side by side without overlapping
criteria.verification: layout.test.ts checks a minimum gap; manual: ?board&players=6&scores=3,3,3,3,3,3

criteria.description: The camera shows the whole track in portrait and can focus on one bunny and go back
criteria.verification: camera.test.ts; manual in 360x700 and 390x700 frames: whole track visible, focus buttons work

criteria.description: Lighting is warm and bright and the board reads with a dark system theme
criteria.verification: manual: checked by eye in the dark system theme; the light theme only swaps the background colour and was not checked by eye

criteria.description: The scene is light: Three.js is lazy-loaded only for the board, it renders on demand, and decorations are instanced
criteria.verification: npm run build: main chunk has no Three.js; code review of board.ts render loop

criteria.description: Tests, typecheck and build pass locally and in CI on the PR
criteria.verification: npm test, npm run typecheck, npm run build; gh pr checks green

criteria.description: Runs smoothly on a real mid-range Android phone
criteria.verification: manual on a phone; reported as not confirmed unless checked
